headline: Growth continues, dividend raised, confident year ahead
summary_short: H&R Block's fiscal fourth-quarter revenue rose 3.0% y/y to $1,144.9M and adjusted diluted EPS grew 4.8% to $2.38; the board raised the quarterly dividend 10% to $0.46/share and issued FY2027 guidance of $6.04-6.24 adjusted diluted EPS.
summary_long: Q4 FY2026 revenue rose 3.0% y/y to $1,144.9M; adjusted diluted EPS grew 4.8% to $2.38 and GAAP diluted EPS grew 4.5% to $2.31. Full-year revenue rose 4.9% to $3.95B and adjusted EPS rose 13.9% to $5.31, aided by fewer shares outstanding from buybacks. FY2026 buybacks totaled $500.3M and total shareholder returns $713.7M; the board raised the quarterly dividend 10% to $0.46/share. The company repaid $350.0M and issued $347.0M of new debt, shifting the balance fully to long-term ($1,491.5M, $0 current); stockholders' equity rose 32.2% y/y to $117.5M. FY2027 guidance: revenue $4.11-4.16B, adjusted EBITDA $1.11-1.14B, adjusted diluted EPS $6.04-6.24.
